# Biography & Background — Dhruvil Mistry
> Background story, philosophy, education, and career path of Dhruvil Mistry.

## Overview
Dhruvil Mistry is an AI Engineer from Mumbai, India. He builds production-grade AI systems, voice agents, and full-stack applications with an emphasis on speed of execution, clean architecture, and delightful user experience.

## Milestones & Education
- Selected at the OpenAI × Outskill Hackathon for Minutz (AI Meeting Intelligence).
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering / Information Technology.
- Creator of open-source AI tools and author of popular technical deep-dives on systems engineering and Voice AI.
